name: Metal Wayfarer
description:
About This Game

One Pilot... An Island to Take Back 

Pilot a customizable mech in Metal Wayfarer, a single-player action shooter built around heavy firepower, boost-powered movement, and battles against giant war-engines. Take contracts, tear through Legion strongholds, and bring the salvage home to build something even more dangerous.



Build Your Kind of Firepower

Your mech is more than a weapon loadout. Swap its torso and legs alongside both arm weapons to change how you move, fight, and survive. Roll into battle on treads, stalk the battlefield on spider legs, or take a biped straight into the firing line.

Pair a roaring minigun with a rocket pod. Line up a railgun shot, sweep a beam across the battlefield, or get close with a flamethrower. Discover stranger weapons that freeze enemies, throw sawblades, or bend gravity. Find a combination that feels right, then put it to work.



Turn Their Army Into Your Arsenal

The Armory is your mobile workshop, following the fighting wherever the contract takes you. Recover Legion schematics from wrecked machines and supply crates, spend your earnings, and fit new parts between battles. Every stronghold pays. Every new schematic opens another possibility.

The Contract

Once a kingdom of farms, fishing towns, and foundries, the island now feeds the Iron Legion's war industry. Its last free soldiers have become Command: a radio, a few scouts, and no army that can face the Legion head-on. So they hired Lark. A wayfarer. A wandering mech pilot with one machine and a reputation for getting the job done. Command pays for each stronghold taken. You keep the salvage. The job ends when the last of the 12 war-engine's falls.
short_desc: Build your mech. Break their war machines. Metal Wayfarer is a single-player action shooter where you swap weapons, torsos and legs, boost through firefights, and bring down towering bosses. Reclaim an occupied island and turn Iron Legion salvage into your next upgrade.
